title: AI SEO: where AI helps with content and optimization, and the human review it still needs
summary: Jacky Chou's guide to using AI for SEO: keyword research, link building, content generation, voice search and analytics prioritization. AI saves time and cuts manual errors, but output still needs human review and personalization. Google penalizes low-value content built to manipulate rankings, not AI origin itself.

principles.text: Google judges AI content on value to the reader, not on whether AI wrote it.
principles.quote: the origin of the content is not an issue; the problem is if the generated content lacks quality and has been created to manipulate the search algorithm.

principles.text: Never publish AI content without a human checking spelling, style, tone, structure and context.
principles.quote: AI content published without a human checker

principles.text: Add your own expertise, experience and brand voice; that real-world perspective is what makes content credible.
principles.quote: Your perspective and real-world experience are what give your content value.

principles.text: AI speeds up keyword research: trends, new ideas, competition analysis and long-tail terms.
principles.quote: AI-powered tools can help creators to identify specific and relevant long-tail keywords which are effective in driving targeted traffic to your website.

principles.text: Use AI to prioritize SEO work: a few high-impact recommendations beat hundreds of low-value tasks.
principles.quote: It is more compelling to offer three recommendations that will greatly boost the website’s statistics.

principles.text: Optimize for voice search by answering the questions people ask; assistants return only one top answer.
principles.quote: voice assistants give one answer only, which is the one at the top of the SERPs.
